testDescription: Compute each employee's regular rate, the weekly average hourly rate across all hours worked, which is the base for overtime and paid-break pay. For piece-rate workers it differs per person and changes every day as pieces accumulate.
Apply California daily overtime: time-and-a-half after 8 hours and double time after 10 in a workday, computed on the regular rate. The two overtime types must be tagged distinctly for the export.
Apply weekly overtime after 40 regular hours in the workweek, alongside the daily rule. The two interact so hours are not counted twice.

Recompute paid-break pay as the weekly average rate moves through the week, since breaks are paid at that average. This is circular: a new day's pieces change the average, which changes prior breaks, which changes the weekly total.
Guarantee that piece-rate earnings meet at least minimum wage averaged across the week, topping up if they fall short. A single day below minimum is acceptable if the week as a whole clears it.
Reconcile the day's minute total to decimal hours so a full 8-hour day reads 8.00, not 7.99, since minutes convert to repeating decimals. The fix adjusts the day's last job card.

Detect short, late, or missed meals against the California thresholds and add a one-hour penalty on a Non Labor penalty job, honoring any waivers. The penalty job carries its own earning code so it exports cleanly.
Confirm every crew has transferred cleanly for the week and treat the job cards as the payroll basis. The payroll summary report is the usual final check.

Generate the payroll file in the customer's accounting format and hand it to the accounting system, which runs its own paycheck calculation. Always preview with a test file first to catch missing earning codes.
Ensure every job's export identifier matches a phase or cost center in the accounting system, the single most common export failure. A mismatch rejects that job's records.
Undo a completed export so its job cards can be corrected and re-exported, distinct from simply re-sending the same file. Reversing un-marks the cards; re-sending just pushes the file again.
Track and report offered versus worked hours for H2A visa workers separately, as their guarantee requires. Parked for Anthony (H2A module off).
Apply different overtime rules and group results by department, which is how multi-state operators run per-state rules. Anthony uses departments even within a single state.
